rungs.note: Three bounded researchers and the orchestrator covered Alaska health, aviation, science, workforce, fisheries, public safety and education stories from September 2nd through September 11th.
The sweep included Alaska Department of Health, UAF T3, NOAA Fisheries, UAA and FAA primary pages and current indexes.
Not needed because an official September 4th award notice supplied an in-window story.
The Alaska Department of Health award workbook supplied the project amount, proposal language, applicant, date and service-area fields.

locked_story.headline: Over the Missing Road
locked_story.dedupe: FRESH on the distinctive Ryan Air rural-health award subject and FlightCrate hero. The last two shipped heroes were SubseaHive and RockGlacierCore. No Dispatch in the 30-day window covered this proposal or its preliminary funding gate.

candidates.headline: Ryan Air wins preliminary funding for autonomous medical aviation
candidates.reason: An official state award workbook supplies a consequential Alaska autonomy proposal, a precise projected award, roadless-community stakes, a visible funding-to-flight gap and an unusually honest test for a hopeful film.

candidates.headline: UAA adds a dry EEG system for AI and brain-computer-interface research
candidates.reason: Explicit AI research and a strong Alaska workforce angle, but the current milestone is equipment acquisition with no study result yet.

candidates.headline: T3 Alaska launches a drone credential path
candidates.reason: Concrete student support and a guaranteed interview make a real workforce win, but the program trains human-operated drones rather than autonomy or AI.

candidates.headline: NOAA charts a path to modernized fisheries surveys
candidates.reason: A careful automation framework with autonomous vehicles and advanced models, but less locally specific and less immediate than the Alaska health award.

candidates.headline: ANTHC receives preliminary funding for pharmacy automation
candidates.reason: A substantial Alaska Native-led health-system proposal, but public materials do not yet establish an implementation mechanism or result.

candidates.headline: Wearable monitoring proposed for Alaska commercial vessels
candidates.reason: Concrete medevac stakes, but unresolved biometric surveillance and employment-screening issues require worker voices absent from the funding notice.
